metadata.framework: Django (Wagtail co-framework; no dedicated Wagtail reference - Django reference applied)
notes: Pass 1 (CWE-022/023/036/073, Path Traversal) only; Phase 2 was NOT started.

Labels were produced by LLM reasoning (glm-5.3 via Claude Code CLI) over the real coderedcms_vuln source tree in 9 batches (S1-S6 source candidates, K1-K3 sink candidates); label_gen.py is a serialization helper only.
Input rows: 206 source-candidate rows and 107 sink-candidate rows from iris/extraction/*.csv; deduplicated by (file, line, callable) into 218 unique labeled sites (143 sources + 75 sinks).

Dedup rules: (a) moduleHint variants (short vs dotted module name) of the same site merged; (b) api vs ast rows of the same call site (json.loads, os.path members) merged; (c) Subscript/Attribute/Attribute() rows of the same (file,line,callable) merged. No raw row was dropped without a mapping - see labels_raw_pass1.json.

Exclusion rationale: migrations/, tests/, project_template/ and the nested coderedcms-db/ tree were already excluded at extraction time (WORKFLOW.md 4.3.2); all remaining CSV candidates are labeled here.

Sanitizers: no sanitizer entries were confirmed - the project's own code contains no base-directory containment, no '..' rejection, no normpath/realpath/safe_join guard executing before any file access; the os.path.splitext checks in forms.py validate file extensions only (explicitly labeled as non-sanitizers). MySanitizers.qll will resolve to none().

Evidence gap (external to this CodeQL database): Django MultiPartParser filename handling, FileSystemStorage.path()/get_available_name()/safe_join containment, wagtail page routing and wagtailimportexport are not part of the 7924-LOC baseline; sink entries whose exploitability depends on that behavior are labeled candidate with confidence <= 0.75 and flagged in phase1_review.md.
login_required / wagtail-admin permissions are contextual (attacker-population) boundaries, not sanitization (django.md section 8).
session_key (server-generated random session id), cr_settings config constants and CLI/operator options are labeled none - not attacker-controlled in this threat model.

entries.rationale: SearchForm(request.GET) in the site-wide search view binds the client query-string (search 's'/'t'); genuine untrusted Django request boundary, but values feed search/ORM lookups only - no filesystem path sink downstream.
request.GET object read in the search view (pagination context); client-controlled query-string boundary - downstream usage is Paginator.page only.
request.GET.get('p', 1) pagination parameter - untrusted query-string value used only for paginator.page(page) at views.py:88.

The `path` parameter of serve_protected_file(request, path) is the URL-injected route variable: coderedcms/urls.py:21-25 registers re_path(r'^{PROTECTED_MEDIA_URL}(?P<path>.*)$', serve_protected_file), so everything below /protected/ (already percent-decoded by Django before routing) arrives as this kwarg. It is joined onto PROTECTED_MEDIA_ROOT at views.py:114 and opened at views.py:117 with no containment guard. The only gate is @login_required (views.py:109), which limits WHO can request, not WHAT path is opened.
